{{Quote|Princess? What princess?''"<br />"''Princess Leia. She's one of the Senators from the Old Republic, originally from Alderaan. We're supposed to escort her while they hand-deliver something important to her. I get the impression our covert listening operation was a success.''"<br />"''I guess I've never met a princess before.''"<br />"''Who has?|Keyan Farlander and [[Hamo Blastwell]]|<ref name="OSG" />}}
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Maria (Lambda-class)|''Maria'']] '''delivered''' the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] aboard the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. The rendezvous was interrupted by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Immortal/Legends|''Immortal'']], but the ''Tantive IV'' escaped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with the plans.

==Prelude==
Using [[Ambush of the Phoenix|stolen]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[communications satellite]]s, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] acquired [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was chosen to carry the plans to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] aboard the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], and a rendezvous was arranged with the Rebel [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Maria (Lambda-class)|''Maria'']].<ref name="XW" />

==The battle==
Three [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] preceded the ''Maria'' to the rendezvous point, arriving to find the ''Tantive IV'' already in the area, hidden among a convoy of CR90 [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] carrying supplies bound for Alderaan. With the ''Tantive IV'' unable to identify itself for fear of arousing Imperial curiosity,<ref name="XW" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] the X-wing designated [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]], began [[Sensor/Legends|scanning]] the corvettes to locate it. When Farlander confirmed the ''Tantive IV'' was present, the ''Maria'' emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to board it.<ref name="OSG" />

Moments later, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Immortal/Legends|''Immortal'']] entered the area and launched eight [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] before quickly jumping back into hyperspace. Farlander used [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] to quickly eliminate two of the Assault Gunboats, before he and the X-wings from [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] the rest. One of the Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] made it past the X-wings and attempted to disable the ''Tantive IV'' with its [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], but Farlander was able to give chase and stop it in time. After the ''Maria'' completed its boarding operation, the ''Tantive IV'' fled to hyperspace and the Rebel ships withdrew.<ref name="OSG" />

==Aftermath==
The ''Tantive IV'' was [[Assault on the Tantive IV|attacked]] once more by the ''Immortal'' upon exiting hyperspace, only to escape with the help of Rebel reinforcements. However, the Empire later succeeded in [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capturing]] the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]<ref name="OSG" /> near [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], in the eleventh mission of "Tour of Duty II: The Great Search", "Deliver Plans to Princess Leia." If the player fails to prevent the ''Tantive IV'' being disabled, the ''Immortal'' returns and attempts to capture it.<ref name="XW" /> However, Farlander's after-action report in ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' confirms that the ship escaped to hyperspace unscathed.<ref name="OSG" />

The delivery of the Death Star plans depicted in ''X-Wing'' differs from the version of events presented in the [[1981]] [[National Public Radio]] [[Star Wars (radio)|adaptation]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], wherein the plans are [[Battle of Toprawa|transmitted]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] to the ''Tantive IV'' while the craft feigns malfunction, before coming under attack from the Star Destroyer [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']].<ref name="Radio">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref>
